text: All of Botswana was covered by a **white** Google car without an antenna.
NOTE: Within Africa, this car can also be found in South Africa, Lesotho and Eswatini.
text_zh: 波札那全境均由一輛沒有天線的**白色** Google 車所拍攝覆蓋。
註：在非洲境內，這款車也可以在南非、賴索托和史瓦帝尼看到。

text: Botswana has **white** front plates and **yellow** rear plates, similar to UK-style plates.
NOTE: Botswana and Namibia are the only countries in southern Africa where yellow rear plates are predominantly found.
text_zh: 波札那擁有**白色**前車牌與**黃色**後車牌，類似英國風格的車牌。
註：波札那是與納米比亞是非洲南部唯二主要使用黃色後車牌的國家。

text: Signs in Botswana are usually in **English**. Most town names, however, are derived from any of the indigenous languages spoken in the country.
NOTE: The Afrikaans language, which is closely related to Dutch and common in South Africa, is very rare in Botswana. You will almost never find Afrikaans place names.
text_zh: 波札那的標誌通常使用**英文**。然而，大多數城鎮名稱是源自該國所使用的某種原住民語言。
註：南非語（Afrikaans，與荷蘭語密切相關且在南非很常見）在波札那非常罕見。你幾乎不會看到南非語的地名。

text: The typical Botswana landscape is **dry and mostly flat**, though a limited amount of elevation can be found in certain regions. Common vegetation includes shrubs, small trees, and occasionally dry, golden grasslands. The soil is arid, sandy and ranges in colour from white to red.
NOTE: The border region of South Africa can have a similar landscape.
text_zh: 典型的波札那景觀為**乾燥且大多平坦**，不過在特定區域仍可看到少許地勢起伏。常見的植被包括灌木、矮樹以及偶爾出現的乾枯金色草原。土壤乾旱呈沙質，顏色從白色到紅色不等。
註：南非的邊境地區可能會有類似的景觀。

text: Like the other countries in Southern Africa, outside road lines (if present) are **yellow**, while centre road lines are **white**.
NOTE: Outside yellow road lines in arid environments also exist in Israel, Palestine, Jordan, and the UAE. However, these countries all drive on the right side.
text_zh: 與非洲南部的其他國家一樣，外側道路標線（若有）為**黃色**，而中央道路標線為**白色**。
註：乾旱環境中的外側黃色道路標線也存在於以色列、巴勒斯坦、約旦和阿拉伯聯合大公國。然而，這些國家都是靠右行駛。

text: Botswana has a unique **black-and-yellow striped signpost**. More rarely, you can see red-and-white signposts.
NOTE: In Southern Africa, these signposts are only found in Botswana.
text_zh: 波札那擁有特殊的**黃黑相間條紋標誌桿**。較罕見的情況下，你也可以看到紅白相間的標誌桿。
註：在非洲南部，這種標誌桿只會在波札那看到。

text: Curbs and guardrails are usually **striped**. Possible colour schemes are black-and-yellow, red-and-white, and black-and-white.
text_zh: 路緣石和護欄通常呈**條紋狀**。可能的配色有黃黑、紅白和黑白。

text: These small **red-and-white chevrons** can sometimes be found next to the road.
NOTE: They are also very common in South Africa.
text_zh: 有時會在路邊看到這些小型的**紅白相間轉彎標誌**。
註：它們在南非也非常常見。

text: Just like the other Southern African countries, direction signs have a **green background**.
The numbers of major roads start with **A**. These road numbers frequently appear on direction signs.
NOTE: Road numbers in South Africa never start with A.
text_zh: 就像其他南部非洲國家一樣，方向指示標誌採用**綠色背景**。
主要道路的編號開頭為 **A**。這些道路編號經常出現在方向指示標誌上。
註：南非的道路編號絕不會以 A 開頭。

text: Some road signs have a **blue background**. This is an older style of sign that was used before signs with white backgrounds were introduced. They are relatively unique to Botswana.
Note that most road signs will have the newer white background.
text_zh: 有些道路標誌採用**藍色背景**。這是引入白色背景標誌前使用的較舊樣式標誌。這在波札那算是相當獨特。
請注意，大多數道路標誌都會使用較新的白色背景。

text: Typical Botswana houses range from small impoverished shacks to comfortable middle-class bungalows. Some buildings have exposed grey bricks. On occasion, you might find traditional round huts.
NOTE: All of these house styles are also found in the other southern African countries.
text_zh: 典型的波札那房屋樣式從貧困的小棚屋到舒適的中產階級平房都有。有些建築物有外露的灰色磚塊。偶爾你也可能會發現傳統的圓形茅草屋。
註：所有這些房屋樣式在其他南部非洲國家也能看到。

text: **Random small blurs** are common in Botswana’s coverage. These blurs are similar to the ones found on licence plates and faces, but they cover seemingly random parts of the panorama instead. This is especially noticeable in urban areas, and mostly absent on more rural roads.
text_zh: **隨機的小型模糊**在波札那的街景覆蓋中很常見。這些模糊類似於在車牌和人臉上看到的模糊，但它們涵蓋的全景位置看似隨機。這在城鎮區域特別明顯，而在較偏遠的鄉村道路上則幾乎沒有。

text: Botswana has many unique and distinct regions throughout the country. This image breaks down the main factors that differentiate each distinctive landscape by soil, vegetation and other clues.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._

RESOURCE: This image was made possible by the invaluable research done by Jasper Woodard. You can check out his [Botswana videos](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-FLhEAs1GfI) on his [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@jasperwoodard8134).
text_zh: 波札那全國各地有許多獨特且截然不同的區域。這張圖片透過土壤、植被和其他線索，拆解出區分每個獨特景觀的主要因素。
_點擊圖片可放大。_
資源：這張圖片歸功於 Jasper Woodard 所做的寶貴研究。你可以在他的 [YouTube 頻道](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-FLhEAs1GfI) 上查看他的 [波札那影片](https://www.youtube.com/@jasperwoodard8134)。

text: Coverage in Botswana is fairly limited due to the country’s sparse road system. In addition to regular paved roads, you can still expect to see some rural unpaved road coverage. The most dense coverage is in the east and near Gaborone. The larger towns have extensive side road coverage.
text_zh: 由於波札那的道路系統稀疏，當地的街景覆蓋相當有限。除了正常的鋪設道路外，你依然有機會看到一些鄉村未鋪設道路的街景覆蓋。最密集涵蓋的區域位於東部以及哈博羅內附近。較大的城鎮則有廣泛的小路街景覆蓋。

text: This map shows which covered roads are **paved**, and which ones are **unpaved**. It is slightly simplified for ease of reading. Small, unpaved side roads in and near towns are not shown.
text_zh: 這張地圖顯示了哪些涵蓋的道路是**鋪設路面**，哪些是**未鋪設路面**。為了方便閱讀已稍作簡化。城鎮內及附近未鋪設的小路並未顯示。

text: Most of Botswana is as flat as a pancake. However, every now and then you will find some elevation. If you see hills, you are most likely in one of the two areas indicated on the minimap.
NOTE: Even in the indicated areas, there are a lot of very flat areas, as many of Botswana’s hills are geographically isolated. Some lone hills may also appear far outside the indicated areas.
text_zh: 波札那的大部分地區都非常平坦。然而，偶爾你還是會發現一些起伏的地勢。如果你看到丘陵，你極有可能位於小地圖上標示的兩個區域之一。
註：即使在標示的區域內，也有很多非常平坦的地方，因為波札那的許多丘陵在地理上都是孤立的。一些孤立的丘陵也可能出現在遠離標示區域的地方。

text: The southeastern region near Gaborone has many **semi-arid hills covered in short shrubs**. If you see a lot of these, you are likely to be in the area between Gaborone and Lobatse.

NOTE: Similar hills can be found elsewhere in the country and across the border in South Africa. If you see a large quantity of them, and use other clues to rule out South Africa, you can be fairly certain that you are in southeastern Botswana.
text_zh: 哈博羅內附近的東南部區域有許多**覆蓋著矮灌木的半乾旱丘陵**。如果你看到很多這種景觀，你很有可能位於哈博羅內與羅巴策之間的區域。
註：在該國其他地方以及南非邊境對面也能找到類似的丘陵。如果你看到大量的此類丘陵，並利用其他線索排除南非，你就能相當確定自己位於波札那東南部。

text: The landscape in the eastern pocket north of Francistown is characterised by **red soil **and a somewhat arid look. The soil in these two areas often looks firm and rocky, rather than sandy or dusty. Trees and bushes with yellowed leaves and other “**autumn**” colours are common. Many trees are bare and withered. You might see fallen leaves on the ground here and there.
text_zh: 法蘭西斯敦以北的東部區域景觀特徵為**紅土**和些許乾旱的外貌。這兩個區域的土壤通常看起來堅硬且多石，而非沙質或多塵。帶有黃葉和其他「**秋天**」色彩的樹木和灌木非常常見。許多樹木皆已枯禿凋零。你可能偶爾會看到地面上的落葉。

text: A large region in the middle western part of the country is characterised by very **white **sandy soil. In addition, the vegetation tends to look **very dry**.
NOTE: Sandy soil can be found in many places in Botswana. This tip specifically refers to the bright white colour of the sand.
text_zh: 該國中西部的大片區域特徵為非常**白色**的沙質土壤。此外，植被往往看起來**非常乾燥**。
註：波札那許多地方都能看到沙質土壤。這個提示特別指的是沙子明亮的白色。

text: The A35 is a very recognisable road: there is always a **power line to your west**. It can also be recognised by its grainy asphalt with faded markings. Many small tracks can be found parallel to the road, disappearing into the bushes.
text_zh: A35 是條非常好辨認的道路：**你的西側總是會有一條電線**。它也可以透過帶有褪色標線的粗糙柏油路來辨識。許多與道路平行的小徑最終消失在灌木叢中。

text: The A33 is characterised by a landscape that is more **lush** than usual. Trees have lots of green leaves and the grass is very tall. The more north you go, the more lush the vegetation becomes.
text_zh: A33 的特徵是比平常更為**茂密**的景觀。樹木長滿綠葉，草非常高。越往北走，植被就越茂密。

text: The road that runs along Botswana’s southern border, through the town of Middlepits, has asphalt with a distinct **red tint**. The landscape is arid. In some sections, slight hills can be seen.
NOTE: Near the town of Middlepits itself, the soil is very red and dotted with small white pebbles.
text_zh: 沿著波札那南部邊境穿過米德爾皮茨（Middlepits）鎮的道路，其柏油路面帶有明顯的**紅調**。景觀乾燥。在某些路段可以看到起伏的小丘陵。
註：在米德爾皮茨鎮本身附近，土壤非常紅，並點綴著白色的小卵石。

text: Gaborone is the capital and largest city. It tends to look **richer and more developed** than the rest of Botswana, though some neighbourhoods may still look impoverished. In some southern parts of the city hills can be seen, but most of the town is flat.
NOTE: The only other place in the country that often looks similar is Francistown.
text_zh: 哈博羅內是波札那的首都兼最大城市。與波札那其他地區相比，它往往看起來**更富有且發達**，儘管有些社區可能看起來依然貧困。在城市的南部某些地方可以看到丘陵，但大部分城鎮都是平坦的。
註：該國唯一看起來類似的地方是法蘭西斯敦。

text: In Francistown, you can often see a** lone hill with radio antennas**, which is located on the north side of the city. This hill is a good way to distinguish Francistown from Gaborone.
NOTE: The town of Serowe has a similar hill with antennas. Here, the towers are taller, red-and-white striped, and the hill has a flat top.
text_zh: 在法蘭西斯敦，你經常可以看到**座落在城市北側、設有無線電天線的孤立丘陵**。這座丘陵是區分法蘭西斯敦與哈博羅內的好方法。
註：塞羅韋（Serowe）鎮也有類似設有天線的丘陵。在這裡，鐵塔更高、帶有紅白相間條紋，且丘陵頂部平坦。

text: Maun is the only relatively large city in Botswana that has this bright **white sandy soil**, which is typical for the middle western region of the country.
text_zh: 馬烏恩是波札那唯一擁有這種亮**白沙質土壤**的相對較大城市，這是該國中西部區域的典型特徵。

text: The western part of the A2 has **overcast coverage**, making it recognisable.
text_zh: A2 的西段有**陰天街景覆蓋**，使其易於辨認。

text: Chobe Flood Plains National Park in the far north has a lot of **small, winding dirt road **coverage, with a lot of it being just south of the Chobe River. It has scattered lush bushes on either side, and you will often find wildlife such as elephants and warthogs.
text_zh: 遠北地區的喬貝沖積平原國家公園（Chobe Flood Plains National Park）擁有許多**狹窄蜿蜒的泥土路**街景覆蓋，其中許多就位於喬貝河以南。兩側散落著茂密的灌木，你經常會看到大象和疣豬等野生動物。

text: This portion of the A30 has a distinct **autumn** feel unique to it. Notably, there are trees with orange coloured leaves lining the road in straight rows. In addition, there is often tall grass as opposed to other autumn looking locations.
text_zh: A30 的這個路段有一種獨特的**秋天**氛圍。值得注意的是，道路兩旁排列著整齊成行的橘色葉片樹木。此外，與其他看起來像秋天的地點不同，這裡通常長有高草。

text: **Salt pans** can be found in central-eastern Botswana. Dirt road coverage can be found leading to the pans and has similar soil and grass, but you can also find many trees along the road. They are mainly found around the Nwetwe pan. The salt pans show up as lakes on the map.
NOTE: A lot of the dirt road coverage near the pans was taken in June, and will feature trees without leaves or those that are beginning to lose their leaves.
text_zh: **鹽沼**可以在波札那中東部找到。前往鹽沼的泥土路街景覆蓋擁有類似的土壤和草地，但你也會在路邊看到許多樹木。它們主要分佈在 Nwetwe 鹽沼附近。鹽沼在地圖上會顯示為湖泊。
註：鹽沼附近許多泥土路的街景拍攝於 6 月，因此會呈現沒有樹葉或開始落葉的樹木。

text: Just outside Gaborone, there is a lot of coverage along very rural, **small dirt tracks**. They can be identified by the orange-red shade of dirt and abundance of green trees and bushes surrounding the road.
text_zh: 在哈博羅內郊外，非常偏遠的**小泥土路**沿線有許多街景覆蓋。它們可以透過橘紅色的泥土以及道路周圍豐富的綠樹和灌木來辨認。

text: The section of the A33 within the Sibuya Forest Reserve and the CT/3 (Tamafupa) Commercial Wildlife Utilisation is **under construction**. This is most visible by the service road or embankment alongside the road.
NOTE: Despite being in the construction zone, some locations may still look normal.
text_zh: 在 Sibuya 森林保護區和 CT/3 (Tamafupa) 商業野生動物利用區內的 A33 路段**正在施工中**。這在路旁的施工道路或堤防中最為明顯。
註：儘管處於施工區域，某些地點看起來可能依然正常。

text: The mostly unpaved road north of Maun to Khwai can be identified by **extremely white sandy soil and tall green trees** surrounding the road. The first section of the road, between Maun and Shorobe, is paved. But that section can still be identified by the trees, faint road markings, and power lines to the west of the road.
text_zh: 從馬烏恩以北通往 Khwai 的大部分未鋪設道路，可透過道路周圍**極為白皙的沙質土壤與高大的綠樹**來辨認。該道路的第一段（馬烏恩與 Shorobe 之間）已鋪設柏油。但該路段仍可透過樹木、模糊的道路標線以及道路西側的電線來辨認。

text: The A20 has mostly **clean, recent asphalt**. Some sections of the road are much **thinner** than usual. The landscape is characterised by red soil, dry grey-coloured trees, and very little grass.
text_zh: A20 大部分鋪有**乾淨且較新的柏油**。該道路的某些路段比平常要**窄**得多。景觀特徵為紅土、乾枯的灰色樹木以及極少的草。

text: Southeast of Tshabong, the A20 has been recently repainted and has very **bright yellow lines** and relatively **dark asphalt**. There is a powerline running alongside it to the northeast, it has orange-tan sandy soil, and you can often find patches of yellow flowers.
text_zh: 在 Tshabong 東南部，A20 最近重新繪製了標線，擁有非常**明亮的黃線**與相對**較暗的柏油**。東北側有一條平行延伸的電線，土壤呈橘棕色沙質，且經常可以看到成片的黃花。

text: The Tsodilo Hills World Heritage Site is memorable due to its **large protruding hills** with exposed rock faces. The coverage around the hills is entirely on dirt roads.
text_zh: 世界遺產 Tsodilo Hills 因其帶有外露岩壁的**巨大突出丘陵**而令人難忘。丘陵周圍的街景覆蓋完全位於泥土路上。

text: These distinctive **silos** are found in Pandamatenga in northeastern Botswana and can be seen all around the town.
text_zh: 這些獨特的**筒倉**可以在波札那東北部的 Pandamatenga 找到，在鎮上各處都可以看到。
